findings.title: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.description: Ground zone on F.Cu has 36% fill ratio. Excessive routing or thermal relief patterns may be reducing ground plane effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio

findings.title: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.description: Ground zone on B.Cu has 43% fill ratio. Excessive routing or thermal relief patterns may be reducing ground plane effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J3
findings.description: Connector J3 (Conn_01x17) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J3. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J3

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J4
findings.description: Connector J4 (Conn_01x17) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J4. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J4

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J3
findings.description: J3 (Conn_01x17) has 3 ground pin(s) for 13 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J3 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J3

findings.title: Clock /MX_SCK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /MX_SCK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock /MX_SCK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock /MX_SCK routed near connector J4
findings.description: Clock net /MX_SCK passes within 2.1mm of connector J4. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /MX_SCK away from J4, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /MX_SCK routed near connector J4

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and In1.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In1.Cu and In2.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In2.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (48×48mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 1464 MHz; (1,0) at 1464 MHz; (1,1) at 2071 MHz; (0,2) at 2928 MHz; (2,0) at 2928 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /LSM_CK
findings.description: Net /LSM_CK has 3 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 2 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /LSM_CK
